notes.title: 0.13.1 Fixs !
notes.content:
Fixes

 Fixed an issue where newly connected clients could disrupt other players' camera.
 Fixed rocket launcher self-kill bug: players could "kill themselves" and trigger killfeed/score, but wouldn’t actually die.
 Dash and Wall Jump cooldowns now properly reset on respawn/restart in JMP mode.
 Fixed dialog interface persisting over the ending event on the tutorial map.
 Fixed startgame event not resetting score or player positions for connected clients.


Other

 Last selected ARN map is now saved.
 Last selected JMP map is now saved.

notes.title: 0.13.0 ! New JMP maps !
notes.content:
Gameplay

 New JMP maps: Tutorial (S6_LWC), Tower (T_C17), Corridor (C_C17), and an "Old map" category with separator.
 Fixed JMP map issue where end_area didn't check for timerOn.
 Added a velocity cap to physics-based projectiles (e.g. rockets are no longer too fast if the player moves quickly).
 Major: Tutorial system implemented.
 Major: Dialog system added.


Graphic

 Brought back the black outline for gamemodes HUD.


Audio

 New SOS sound effects added.
 Added announcer audio bus.
 Added landing sound.
 Fixed jump/walk sounds not playing when bhopping.
 Enemy explosions now spawn at the correct location.


Other

 Added a delay before SOS explosions trigger.

notes.title: 0.11.3 smoller update
notes.content:
Hey again, quick update while i'm still working on the things.
Still polishing things and squashing bugs while prepping the bigger stuff in the background. This one's mostly cleanup and graphics-related improvements, but it should make things looks better overall. Thanks for sticking with it.

Graphics

 DirectionalLight now casts shadows for all players.
 General graphic adjustments.


Fix

 Temporarily disabled scaling3D due to visual artifacts.
 Graphics settings now properly apply when entering the game.
 Replaced the cube limit with a smoother triangle ramp in Threeway.
 Fixed multiple issues related to explosive bullets.

notes.title: 0.11.2 smoll update
notes.content:
First of all thanks for keeping up with the game !
I'm currently working on better content, like remaking JMP maps to have complete environments in line with the game """lore""" or tweaking the arena game mode for it to be fun (if it's not in 6 months i'm scrapping it).
I've also started to work on a good Bot AI to fill in servers.

Gameplay

 Grenade-Launcher refont (not finished).
 Increased all weapon hit slow.
 Shorten weapon switch time.
 Changed the explosion boosting mechanic to be more consistant (it needs adjustments).
 Remade the Jumper.


Graphics

 Explosion vfx ++.
 Reduced killfeed display duration.


Other

 Can now binds two buttons on the same action.
 Can now lock fps to a defined value.


Fix

 Fixed blood decals spawning at 0,0.
 Fixed third person weapon models desync.
 Fixed some sfx not playing.
 Fixed hitpoint desync issues.

notes.title: 0.11.1 Fixs !
notes.content:
Graphics 
 
 Slide animation for announcements. 
 Gamemode HUD rework. 
 Custom killfeed player color for devs. 
 Added killfeed icons. 


Other 

 Chat BBCode independence: Each chat BBCode tag is now independent from the previous message. 


Fixs 

 Fixed flare color bug. 
 Fixed Steam guide for gamemode cube and start weapons. 
 Fixed leaderboard rank label covering PP. 
 Fixed explosion sound. 
 Fixed scoring while in lobby wait.

Gameplay

 Movement rework: Better air control, more weight in the air, coyote time.
 Added melee damage from the velocity when hitting a target.
 Arena Gamemode ! (In testing, if it's fun we'll develop it, otherwise trash!)
 Team system update: colored nicknames and player outlines, score persistance, and defined team spawn points.
 Player spawns now check if there is a player close to is to avoid spawning on other players.
 Added fastFallRatio (the longer you fall the faster).
 New JMP maps (jmp-surf and jmp-bhop).


Graphic

 First person UI rework. (Chat, stats, annonces, etc).
 Weapons VFX rework.
 Added an explosion decal.
 "Dither" graphic option (enabled by default).


Audio

 Added weapon switch SFX.
 Shorten the hitmarker SFX to be spamable.


Other

 Workshop ! Consult the guides (from BulletSpeed not the Playtest).
 Leaderboard on JMP and ARN maps.
 Added console commands for movement config.
 Trenchbroom config update (spotlight, textures, etc).



Fixs

 No more grey screen of death !
 Object spawner now sync properly between server and clients (less bandwith usage too).
 Fixed russian localization.
 Fixed shotgun ammo consuption.
 Other little fixs.

Gameplay

 Team Deathmatch gamemode.
 JMP maps rework + new map.
 Automatic lobby wait.
 Weapons buff/nerf (surprise surprise).
 Foot and forearm hitboxes.


Graphic

 Third person camera for death and emote animations.
 New death animation.
 UI above player heads reworked.
 Annonce message adjustments.
 Small hitmarker rework.


Other

 New server custom options.
 Console with commands.
 Trenchbroom gameconfig update.



Fixs

 Explosion didn't add the kill to the shooter.
 Other littles fixs.

Gameplay

 Adjusted crouch height and collisions.
 Touching a surf ramp enables the dash.


Other

 Multiplayer server options in its own menu.
 Discord link in main menu.
 Steam guide on special texture, clip etc.


Fixs

 When you switched weapon while charging melee you couldn't shoot.
 Inspect anim blocking from shoothing.
 Fix special texture not applying on custom maps.

Gameplay
Better surfing upward on ramps.

Fixs
MANY
